forge.audit.role.province_id: Province ids of the previous map
forge.canvas.cells: Grid: {cells} cells ({fixed}). Target: {land} land and {sea} sea provinces.
forge.canvas.free: it will be fixed when you leave this screen
forge.canvas.note: The game loads other sizes if they are multiples of 8, but the camera and the minimap expect 5616×2160 [verify in game].
forge.details.note: All suggested straits are exported to adjacencies.csv. You can remove or add them later in Map › Straits.
forge.done.text: Done: {files} files with {provinces} provinces are in the mod, unsaved. The workshop project “{name}” goes with them. Save the mod (Ctrl+S) to write them; Undo removes the whole export.
forge.flags.title: Flags of the new countries (the main one; the export also writes one per government)
forge.help.canvas: Map size and number of provinces. The cell grid is fixed when you leave this screen: nothing you do later moves it.
forge.help.climate: Latitudes, temperatures, rain and amount of rivers.
forge.help.details: Suggested straits between nearby coasts and the largest gap accepted.
forge.help.done: The map is now an ordinary map of the mod.
forge.help.economy: Total population; POP dates come from the installation.
forge.help.import: Your own drawn bitmaps. Whatever is missing is rebuilt.
forge.help.names: Province and state names. Double-click on the preview to rename.
forge.help.owners: Share the map among existing countries or leave it without owners.
forge.help.provinces: How many provinces and how similar in size.
forge.help.relief: Relief template (the 14 by Azgaar) and brushes to touch it up.
forge.help.review: Final render, problems, audit and file plan before exporting.
forge.help.start: Choose what to do, where the map comes from and the workshop project name.
forge.help.states: Provinces per state and continent names.
forge.help.terrain: When there are hills and mountains and how much land is farmland.
forge.import.hint: Drag the files here or pick them one by one. With provinces already drawn, the workshop only computes what is missing.
forge.install.ready: Installation learned: {tags} TAGs with land, {dates} POP dates, {continents} continents and {climates} climates.
forge.install.synthetic: No game map: the procedural palette is used.
forge.level.map.text: A new map for the countries that already exist: provinces, terrain, rivers, states, continents, climates, owners, population and names.
forge.level.overlay.text: New provinces and continents in a free area of the existing map.
forge.level.world.text: Besides the map, new countries, cultures and culture groups, with their flags, parties, government and a religion from the installation. The countries that already existed are left without land.
forge.names.col.name: Name
forge.names.hint: Edit the Name column; the change survives regenerating earlier steps.
forge.origin: Where does the map come from?
forge.origin.fmg_json: Import a JSON from Azgaar's Fantasy Map Generator (Export to JSON → Full)
forge.param.auto_targets: Same number as vanilla, scaled with the area
forge.plan.summary: {generate} new files, {modify} modified, {trash} to the trash and {empty} emptied; {size} in total.
forge.provinces.note: For pixel-level touch-ups, export and use Map › World.
forge.quick.tooltip: Everything with default values and straight to the review.
forge.review.confirm: I understand and want to go on: {problem}
forge.review.fix_later: Suggested fix: “{fix}”. This version of the workshop does not apply it by itself yet: do it by hand or leave it if the warning does not affect you.
forge.review.no_project: Open a project to export the map.
forge.review.ready: Ready to export: {provinces} provinces ({land} land and {sea} sea) in {files} files.
forge.saved: Workshop project “{name}” stored in the mod (not written until you save).
forge.screen.start: What do you want to do?
forge.stats.none: There is no world yet: generate or import one.
forge.stats.owners: {tags} TAGs receive land; {owned} of {land} provinces have an owner. {list}
forge.stats.provinces: {land} land and {sea} sea provinces. Median area {median} px; the smallest, {smallest} px.
forge.stats.world: {countries} new countries ({civilized} civilised) in {groups} culture groups; {owned} of {land} provinces have an owner. {list}
forge.subtitle: Generate or import a new map with its resources and export it to the mod in a single undoable operation.
forge.target.no_project: No project open: you can generate and look, but not export.
forge.target.this_mod: Target: this mod ({mod}). {trash} mod files under replaced folders would go to the trash.
forge.terrain.note: The exact terrain.bmp index is chosen per state among those your installation uses.
